desc: 格纹吊带收腰中长裙：版型、织纹面料与裙摆垂坠三线收口
leaf: 格纹吊带收腰中长连衣裙
name: 格纹吊带收腰中长裙款

shots.intent: 用砖墙与垂叶的强氛围场加双行大标题，在详情页首屏一秒锁定点击流量。
shots.textZone: 顶部居中药丸描边框；上部 30% 双行大字标题区；标题下一枚竖三点分隔符与一行细副标题；人物躯干不压字

shots.intent: 把吊带宽度、领口塑形与前片省道一次讲清，用结构证明版型而非喊话。
shots.textZone: 右侧纵向两枚线框圆环标注，各配粗体短标签与一行细注；底部一条居中标题带

shots.intent: 侧面机位把裙身放进真实夏日街巷，让买家把自己代入穿搭场景。
shots.textZone: 上部左侧药丸描边框加双行标题，反白压在虚化墙面上

shots.intent: 低机位拍迎风裙摆，把垂坠、克重感与摆量做成可见证据。
shots.textZone: 图片下方白色标题带：左侧粗体短标签，右侧一行细注

shots.intent: 把四个工艺点位并排同框，让读者一次比完再往下滑。
shots.textZone: 四卡下方各一枚粗体短标题与一行细注，两列两行排布

shots.intent: 后侧高机位一眼说清收腰与摆量关系，承担第二屏的核心利益主张。
shots.textZone: 右侧纵向两枚线框圆环标注与粗体短标题；顶部药丸描边框一行

shots.intent: 用指数条与规整表格回答选码疑虑，数字全部留给商家后填。
shots.textZone: 整屏为结构化占位文案区：标题带、三行五档指数条、七列六行占位表格、四格纤维小卡

shots.intent: 以原料与织纹微距承担信任，不写任何资质与检测话术。
shots.textZone: 顶部药丸描边框与双行标题；左侧一列三枚超大号占位数据卡；卡片底部一行细注

shots.intent: 尾屏回扣整衣廓形并用占位行动条收口，避免促销数字外溢。
shots.textZone: 上部双行收口标题；底部一枚描边行动按钮与一行细注，不含数字与价格

style.backgroundSystem: four alternating real backdrops held to one depth language: aged brick #A2503C under hanging ivy foliage #1C3A2C, a sun-washed pale concrete alley #C9C6C1 with warm bokeh #C9A882, a raw woven fabric field #E8E8E6, and paper-white #FFFFFF infographic panels with card grey #DCDCDC slots
style.iconSystem: thin monoline circular pictograms in #2D2D2D and hairline ring annotation markers over photos; no filled, gradient or 3D icons
style.lightingSystem: soft directional daylight from upper left, open-shade fill on the shadow side, gentle contact shadows, 5200-5800K film colour; infographic screens stay even flat high-key
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent warm editorial womenswear detail-page visual system across the entire set; fixed palette of paper-white field #FFFFFF, ink #2D2D2D, card grey #DCDCDC and one product-matched accent #6BAED6, with scene anchors aged brick #A2503C, ivy foliage #1C3A2C and pale concrete #C9C6C1; warm tone; one modern geometric sans-serif family; a recurring hairline pill badge with a small-caps kicker above a two-line ink headline, a vertical three-dot divider and one hairline sub-caption; backdrops alternate between brick under ivy, a pale concrete alley, a raw woven fabric field and paper-white infographic panels; soft directional daylight from upper left with open-shade fill, gentle contact shadows, 5200-5800K film colour; thin monoline circular pictograms and hairline ring callouts only; the garment keeps its true weave, drape, weight and silhouette at stable scale; no palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no QR codes, no store badges.
noDrift: no QR codes, store badges or membership marks
no real size, weight, composition or price numbers
style.presentationRules: garment always reads with true weave, drape, weight and silhouette; the same hem line and waist seam in every angle; model face never identifiable (turned away, cropped above the chin or obscured by a prop); occupancy pinned per shot type
style.surfaceSystem: matte mortar brick, weathered concrete, raw woven cloth, paper-white card stock; no gloss floor, no acrylic stand
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family; hairline pill badge with a small-caps kicker above a two-line bold headline in #2D2D2D (headline 28-44pt), a vertical three-dot divider, one hairline sub-caption at 12-14pt; all rendered copy is placeholder-driven, never source copy
